purpose: Chainlink oracle-boundary evidence-intake register (Goal 2). Measures what oracle evidence establishes and what it does not. This is a measurement register, not an endorsement, integration claim, partnership claim, canonical-oracle claim, price feed, or compliance conclusion.

subjects.display_name: Chainlink ETH/USD data feed, Ethereum mainnet
source_families: Ethereum public chain state via read-only RPC

subjects.display_name: Chainlink official documentation (concepts, update conditions, proof-of-reserves)

boundary_axioms: A valid signature (node, publisher, or CSOAI Ed25519) proves provenance of bytes, never price truth.
An on-chain aggregator read establishes what the contract reported at read time, not what any venue traded at.
Feed identity is the triple (chainId, aggregator address, description()); any one element alone is insufficient.
Staleness, missing round metadata, and wrong-chain reads are failure modes the instrument must detect, not average away.
Asset performance and price accuracy are not governance quality; no axis maps price level to operator quality.
promotion_rules: No subject is signed until the canonical evidence object and its raw-source hashes are present.
No Rekor, OTS, SCITT, root, or distribution state may be inferred from a local file or planned command.
No public distribution occurs until served-byte readback succeeds.
No integration, partnership, or canonical-oracle claim without external confirmation.
Status remains CANDIDATE_UNMEASURED until the pinned instrument, grader, complete denominator, run output, and signed card all exist and reconcile.
